title: Imam e Zamana
body:
👉Imam e Zamana
👉ManqabatKhwan: Mesum Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
👉Mixing/Arrangement/Mastering: Zain Yaqoob (ZDS Studios)
<<DIVIDER>>
👉DOP: Saroj Bunty (Saroj Studios)
👉1st AD: Shabbir Ali Rizvi (USA)
👉Editor & Post Production: Ali Arman Baltistani (Tna Records)
👉SEO Management / Coordinator / Cover Art: Yawer Damani (YAD Graphics)
<<DIVIDER>>
— Lyrics —
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghulamon ki nazrein tumhein dhoondti hain
Bata do thikaana Imam-e-Zamana
Hamare liye hai baghair aap ke yeh jahan
Qaid-khaana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Zara al-‘ajal ki sada ko asar do, humein apne aane ki kuch to khabar do
Kahan tak humein aur furqat ke gham mein
Hai aansu bahaana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Yeh dil chahta hai ke ab aap aayen, jo haalat hai sab rubaru hum sunaayen
Karen behte paani pe likh likh ke kab tak
Areeza rawaana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Bohat zulm har simt barhne laga hai, faqat be-gunaahon ka khoon beh raha hai
Zaroori bohat ho gaya hai tumhara
Zamaane mein aana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Sada tum ko deen-e-Nabi de raha hai, yahan waqt ka phir Yazeed aa gaya hai
Chale aao ghaibat ka parda utha kar
Hussain-e-Zamana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Suna hai ke koi jazeera hai aisa
Jahan baith kar tum chalaate ho duniya
Ke pohancha do ab us jazeere ki had mein
Hamara safeena
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Hasad, bughz o keena, riya-kaariyan hain, hamare amal ke sabab dooriyan hain
Jo hum saaf-dil hon to ho jaaye mumkin
Tumhein dekh paana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Khataein hamari jo hain bakhshwa do, humein jaisa tum chahte ho bana do
Gunahgaar ko bhi karam baantta hai
Tumhara gharana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Yeh dil saari duniya se toota hua hai
Tumhare siwa kaun ab aasra hai
Sunaayen na tum ko to kis ko sunaayen
Yeh gham ka taraana Imam-e-Zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Tumhare bina muddatein hain guzaari
Tum aao na aao yeh marzi tumhari
Hilaal aur Maysam ka hai kaam tum ko
Musalsal bulaana Imam-e-Zamana
